name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium
tagline: Selenium WebDriver backend for the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launch Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari (plus Selenium Grid), isolate sessions, and cover polling, tabs, frames, and plans.
description: Selenium WebDriver backend for the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launch Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari (plus Selenium Grid), isolate sessions, and cover polling, tab/frame/dialog/keyboard helpers, typed element controls, automation plans, and DI registration.

examples.title: First steps

sections.title: Browser layer ([`Browser/`](Browser))
items: **`BrowserUrlRedaction`.** Fragment/query-string redaction used in logs when `MaskSensitiveUrlsInLogs` is set.

sections.title: Service layer ([`Service/`](Service))
items: **`ISeleniumBrowserSession`.** Scoped session (`Tabs`, `Browser`, dispose to release WebDriver resources).
`SeleniumExecutionContextFactory` / `SeleniumExecutionContext`. Wiring used by the automation runners.

sections.title: Settings ([`Configuration/`](Configuration))
rows: Headless mode where the engine allows it.
When set, drives `RemoteWebDriver` against a standalone server / Selenium Grid.
Use `AddArgument(key, value?)` to append `key=value` (or bare key) entries. `disable-gpu` is omitted: it forces SwiftShader, a bot-detection tell.
JS injected via CDP `Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument` (Edge/Chrome only). Bypass bot-detection traps.
Required for CDP-based network observation in `IWebAutomationNavigator.NavigateAsync`. Disable on sites that detect CDP, then provide a JS interception script in `StartupScripts`.
When true, pick from `ViewportSizes` (or `DesktopDisplaySize.Common`) once at `StartBrowserAsync`.
Pool and optional ±pixel jitter for session-start randomization.
When an `IMetrics` is registered, emit instrumentation.
Deep copy used to derive session-specific options.
sections.lead:
Application-wide defaults live on [`SeleniumBrowserOptions`](Configuration/SeleniumBrowserOptions.cs); `SeleniumSessionOptions` is the per-session subclass passed to
`CreateSession`. Configuration section: `"SeleniumBrowserOptions"`.
sections.trail: A fluent builder over the options record is `SeleniumBrowserOptionsBuilder`.

sections.title: Typed element controls ([`Controls/`](Controls))
sections.text: Wrappers over `IWebElement` for typed interactions: `WebElementControl` (base), `InputControl` (`SendKeys`, `Value`), `TextAreaControl`, `ButtonControl`, `LinkControl`, `SelectControl`, `CheckboxControl`. Resolve via `SeleniumBrowser` element APIs and hold them across explicit waits.

sections.title: WebDriver and automation ([`WebDriver/`](WebDriver), [`Automation/ElementLocatorMapping.cs`](Automation/ElementLocatorMapping.cs))
sections.text: Driver-factory helpers (Edge / Chrome / Safari / Firefox + Remote) and the locator mapping that lets `Lyo.Web.Automation` JSON automation plans target Selenium-style locators.

sections.title: DI registration ([`Service/Extensions.cs`](Service/Extensions.cs))
rows: Singleton `SeleniumBrowserOptions`, scoped `SeleniumBrowser` for direct injection (legacy style).
Same, with an explicit options instance.
Above plus singleton `ISeleniumBrowserService` (use this for session-based usage via `CreateSession`).
